notes.title: 2023/8/18 Update Log
notes.content:
Added 8 new languages
Russian, Spanish, Portuguese, French, Polish, Turkish, Thai, Italian.

Skill adjustments and bug fixes:

1. Adjusted Deadly Rhythm to be activated when using a main damage skill
2. Adjusted Cursed Energy to add all carried curse effects when normally attacking, if there is any curse effect on the target, normal attack damage additionally increases by 50%/100%/200%.
3. Fixed a bug that did not correctly add bonuses for Wolfman Form Gold and Legendary Cards
4. Fixed a bug that allowed Dragon Form to infinitely stack additional damage
5. Fixed a bug that allowed Dragon Form to get pet bonuses even when not transformed
6. Fixed a bug that prevented Dragon Form from triggering Deadly Rhythm
7. Fixed a bug that prevented Dragon Form from triggering Time Shield
8. Optimized text description for Dragon Form
9. Fixed a bug that allowed Soul Strike to repeatedly gain damage bonuses from Boss Fight and Curse Boost
10. Fixed a bug that allowed Soul Strike to have its survival time refreshed by a Summon Fusion
11. Fixed a bug that caused automatic pathfinding issues in certain scenarios
12. Fixed a bug that prevented background music from being turned off in certain scenarios
13. Fixed a bug that prevented Moonbeam, FrostNova and Combat Bond Skill from being multiple released when triggered

notes.title: 2023/8/10 Update Log
notes.content:
New Challenge Mode:
In Challenge Mode, players can challenge other players' completed saves in Classic Mode or upload their own completed saves for others to challenge.

New Achievement System:
Added 21 achievements.

Other Changes:
1.All buff skills now simultaneously benefit from attack speed and casting speed bonuses.
2.Carnivorous Plant no longer benefits from Warlock synergy's summoning quantity bonus.
3.Gambler: Adjusted to a 6-star card, increased critical damage adjustment to 200%/400%/800%.
4.Balance: Adjusted to a 5-star card, skill effect adjusted so that all cards are considered as 3/4/5 stars.
5.Chaos bonus: Adjusted so that for each different synergy activated, Chaos damage is increased by 15%/30%/60%, with a maximum of 120%/240%/480%.
6.Hand of Fate: Adjusted to a 5-star card. The damage you inflict fluctuates between 1% and 275%/350%/500%.
7.Fixed a bug where Dragon Form would cause Resurrection and Summon Skeleton to malfunction.
8.Fixed a bug where Loot Box would trigger the Wolfman Form.
9.Fixed a bug where the bottom-left avatar did not switch correctly.
10.Optimized some text descriptions.
11.Added the ability to view synergies and card descriptions in the Three-in-One Reward selection interface and the Card Collection interface.

notes.title: 2023/7/4 Update log
notes.content:
Card adjustments:

1.Metamorphosis:Transform into a demon, increasing your maximum life by 100%. Additionally, devour your summoned creatures, increasing your attack power by 25% for each creature devoured, lasting for 10 seconds.
Legendary quality of Metamorphosis no longer devours all summoned creatures. Now, all qualities only devour their own summoned creatures. Increase in health is now a fixed value across all levels and is no longer affected by the number of devoured creatures.
2.Best Friends!:Your one random summon's attack is increased by 50%/100%/200%.Buffs that you can are shared to your summons.
3.Loot Box：When you lose all your shield, randomly cast a skill. Random but normal/Golden/ledgend.It can be triggered up to 3 times per second.
Arcane Bond can increases the trigger rate per second.


Bug fixes:

1.Fixed a bug where BestFrend！ would cause summoned creatures to share the character's bond.
1.Fixed a bug where opening a blind box would trigger Wolfman Form.

notes.title: 2023/6/16 Update log
notes.content:
Added a new skill - Frost Nova.
Frost Nova：Launch a frost explosion, dealing 40%/60%/120% area frost damage to the surrounding region.Each additional projectile,FrostNova will cast 1 additional time.

notes.title: Add a battle mode
notes.content:
1.Added a new mode - Battle Mode
A battle royale mode with no limit on the number of players. The host creates a room, and others can join by entering the room ID.
In Battle Mode, players receive 20 gold coins per round. At the end of each preparation phase, players will battle against other players' mirror images.
Failing to defeat a mirror image results in losing life points equal to the mirror player's shop level. Losing all life points leads to defeat, and the last surviving player is victorious.
Damage received increases after 10 rounds.

2.Added the ESC key to bring up the menu and go back to the previous level.

3.Transformation skills can now gain summon-related bonuses after transforming, such as Fury and Nature's Aura.

4.Added highlight indicators for cards already in the shop.

5.Optimized damage number display.

notes.title: 5.12 Update
notes.content:
Newly added 3 skills:

Dragon Form: Transform into a dragon form for 15 seconds. In this form, each attack unleashes all skills, and your active skill damage is increased by 60/120/240%.

Wolfman Form: Transform into a wolfman for 15 seconds. In this form, only basic attacks are allowed, each increasing damage by 7.5/15/30% for 3 seconds with independent durations.

Deadly Rhythm : Each active skill cast increases damage by 10/20/40% for 3 seconds. Each stack of the buff has an independent duration.


Adjustments to Treeman Form:

Now, Treeman Form must cast active damage skills to receive a bonus, to avoid excessive damage stacking effects from buff skills.
The description of the Treeman Form has been modified. Now, the first skill cast also receives a damage bonus.

notes.title: 2023/5/6_8:37 Update
notes.content:
Adds three new skills

1.Treant Form：Your skills will be cast in alternating order.All skills that you actively cast gain +60%/120%/240% damage,Each time a different skill is cast,Damage of the next skill will be multiplied by 160%/220%/340%.
After transforming, one can enjoy the Druid bond bonus; damage bonus resets when casting the same skill. The calculation between multiple Treant forms is additive, for example, with one normal quality Treant form, each skill cast is *(100+60)%, with two it becomes *(100+60+60)%, and with three it is *(100+60+60+60)%, instead of *160% *160% *160%.

2.Carnivorous Plant：When your summoned creature dies, it will summon 1 carnivorous plant.Lasts 5 seconds.
Carnivorous Plant will not repeatedly summon itself upon death.

3.Soul Strike：Launch a melee strike, dealing 50%/75%/150% physical damage in an area and summon a Spirit,Spirit dies after one attack,Max 2.
Spirit damage deals equal this damage


Bug Fixes:

1.Fixed a bug where triggering the death of a sprite would cause the triggering skill to become ineffective.
2.Fixed a bug where the death of a golem would cause the maximum number of golems to be abnormal.
3.When fighting against one's own boss, the damage reduction has been changed to life/shield enhancement instead, to avoid situations where only 1 point of damage can be dealt. Skills that cause damage based on life/shield will have their values lowered correspondingly in boss battles to maintain consistency with normal damage values.
4.Fixed a bug where the damage bonus display text would not be hidden when abandoning a boss battle.
5.Fixed a bug where some card descriptions would exceed the boundary.

notes.title: New mode update
notes.content:
1. New Mode Added: Quick Mode
1.1 In Quick Mode, players won't turn into a BOSS and can directly clear the level with a single character.
1.2 Quick Mode has a total of 30 floors, with changes to enemy spawning logic to be full-screen swarm, while reducing battle duration.
1.3 In Quick Mode, players will receive a fixed 5 gold coins per round, which can be carried over to the next round, and for every 10 gold coins held, players will gain 1 gold coin interest, with a maximum interest of 5 gold coins.
1.4 Quick Mode has a total of 5 difficulty levels ranging from easy to hard, clearing lower difficulties will unlock the next difficulty for all classes.
1.5 Upgrading the shop in Quick Mode requires less gold than in the normal mode.
1.6 In Quick Mode, all 9 card slots are unlocked at the start of the game.


2. Synergy Adjustments
2.1 Added Chaos Synergy
Activation requirements: 1/3/5, for each other synergy activated, Chaos damage is increased by 20%/45%/85%.

2.2 Added Shield Synergy
Activation requirements: 3/5/7, shield cap x150%/235%/350%, shields can block up to 67%/75%/80% damage.

2.3 Removed Enhance Synergy.

2.4 Warrior Synergy now increases AoE skill range and damage increase.
Warrior: AoE skill range +20%/40%/80%, AoE damage x150%/235%/350%.

2.5 Combat Synergy changed to allow skills to gain combo effects.
Combat: Combat skills can be cast an additional 1/2/3 times, each additional cast +0%/20%/40% damage.

2.6 Arcane Synergy now increases skill trigger frequency.
Arcane: Skill trigger frequency +50%/135%/250%.
Arcane Synergy can increase the damage trigger frequency of skills like Whirlwind Slash, Storm, Breath, Frost Orb, etc., and the trigger frequency of critical casting, shield aura, and other skills.

2.7 Fire Synergy damage is no longer a fixed percentage, but now deals percentage damage based on the triggering skill's current damage.
Fire: Deals 20%/45%/85% of the current damage as AoE fire damage, triggering up to 5 times per second.

2.8 Frost Synergy now increases all damage taken by enemies.
Frost: After being hit by a Frost skill, target takes +15%/35%/65% damage, stacking up to 5 times.

2.9 Hunter, Shaman, Nature, Druid, Lightning, Warlock have undergone some numerical adjustments.
Hunter: Activation requirements: 3/5/7, Attack speed +50%/135%/250%.
Shaman: Activation requirements: 3/5/7, Cast speed +50%/135%/250%.
Nature: Activation requirements: 3/5/7, Max health x150%/235%/350%.
Lightning: Activation requirements: 3/5/7, Extra bounces 1/2/3 times, bounce damage reduction 50%/20%/0%.
Druid: Pet attack power x150%/235%/350%.
Warlock: Summon limit x1.5/2/3, number of summons per cast +0/+1/+2.

2.10 Card synergy combinations are no longer limited to one class and one auxiliary element; now a card can have up to 3 synergies, and the same synergy can appear.


3. Skill Changes
3.1 Added new card: Trigger Sprite.
Trigger Sprite (Warlock) (Arcane) (5-star).
Summon 1 Trigger Sprite, which will cast triggered skills on your behalf for 10 seconds, with a limit of 2 sprites. Your triggered damage increases by 0%/50%/100%.
Skills that can be triggered by Trigger Sprites: Skills triggered by hit-casting/critical-casting/mystery box mechanics, shield explosion, explosion generated by removing defense-boosted shields.
Trigger Sprites only change the position of skill triggering; the skill effect calculation is still based on the original attributes. Summoning more Trigger Sprites indirectly increases the trigger frequency.

3.2 Added a batch of new cards that combine different attribute bonds, totaling 9 cards.
3-star: Physical damage with additional Lightning, Physical damage with additional Frost, Physical damage with additional Flame.
Physical skills deal an additional 40%/80%/160% of the respective elemental damage and can trigger corresponding elemental bonds.
5-star: Flame with additional Lightning, Flame with additional Frost, Frost with additional Flame, Frost with additional Lightning, Lightning with additional Flame, Lightning with additional Frost.
Elemental skills deal an additional 40%/80%/160% of the respective elemental damage and can trigger corresponding elemental bonds.

3.3 Added new card: Berserker's Blood.
Berserker's Blood (Warrior) (Combat) (4-star).
For every 1% of HP lost, physical damage increases by 1%/2%/4%.

3.4 Auras now affect all targets, with an additional increase in aura effects on summons.
Nature Aura, Hunter Aura, and Shaman Aura have been reduced from 3-star to 2-star.
Flame Aura, Frost Aura, and Lightning Aura have been reduced from 5-star to 4-star.
Auras no longer provide additional bonds.
Lone Wolf no longer causes auras to only affect the user.

3.5 Flamestorm, Froststorm, Lightning Storm, and Blade Storm have been reduced from 5-star to 3-star.
Sword Qi Slash and Boomerang have been reduced from 3-star to 1-star.
Ultimate Flow and Volley have been reduced from 6-star to 3-star.
Flat Shot has been reduced from 2-star to 1-star.
Critical Casting has been reduced from 5-star to 3-star.
Attack Warcry and Elemental Warcry have been increased from 2-star to 3-star.
Doppelganger has been increased from 1-star to 2-star.

3.6 Enhanced Attack bonus has been increased, raised from 3-star to 4-star.
Enhanced Attack: After casting a skill, your next basic attack deals 150%/300%/600% more damage; after a basic attack, your next skill damage increases by 100%/200%/400%.

3.7 Adjustments to Critical Casting and Hit Casting.
Critical Casting can now trigger all connected active skills to the right.
Hit Casting now always triggers the skill on the right.
Critical Casting and Hit Casting can now trigger various curse/BUFF/summon active skills.

3.8 Golem-related changes.
Different attribute golems now share a summon limit.
The HP increase of Stone Circle has been removed.
Golems now initially use a strike skill corresponding to their attribute.

3.9 Chain Reaction now increases the trigger count of Flame Bond by 3/6/12.

3.10 Penetration cards are now renamed to Boomerang.
Boomerang: Your projectiles have a boomerang effect and unlimited penetration, dealing +0%/50%/100% damage.

3.11 Fireball can now penetrate all targets.

3.12 The number of projectiles in Lightning Chain has been increased to 3.

3.13 Arcane Missile has been changed to deal area damage.

3.14 Barrage and Flat Shot can now penetrate all targets.

3.15 Chaos Orb can now penetrate all targets.

3.16 The number of projectiles in Divine Judgment has been increased, but it no longer deals area damage.

3.17 Sword Qi Slash can now be modified by area increase and area damage boost.

3.18 Projectile skills and explosion effects no longer directly cause projectiles to disappear.

3.19 The stacking mechanism of Elemental Curse and Vulnerability Curse has been removed.
The range of curse skills has been increased, the cooldown has been changed to 3 seconds, and the duration is now 5 seconds.
They now provide a 120%/180%/340% bonus to physical/elemental damage.

3.20 Pain Curse has been reduced from 4-star to 2-star.

3.21 Curse Aura no longer enhances the effects of all curses, instead only providing a 20%/50%/150% curse effect boost to the first curse card to its right.

3.22 Area Increase has been removed.

4. Sound/Visual/UI Changes
Numerous skills have undergone sound and visual changes and optimizations.
